kindHint.habit: Something you repeat: three times a week, every weekday.
kindHint.shared: Something you do together, like dinner out once a month.
kindHint.financial: Save an amount, with or without a deadline.
kindHint.project: A goal with steps that can become tasks.

scopeHint.personal: Only you check in and edit. Your partner only sees it if you allow it.
scopeHint.household: You both follow and edit it.

card.viewOnly: {{name}} shared this goal with you. You can see the title, the due date and the progress.

progress.unavailable: Available when Finances is turned on

empty.title: No goals yet
empty.body: There are four types: habit (something you repeat), shared goal (something you do together), financial (save an amount) and project (with steps). Start with one.

module.title: Turn on Goals to get started
module.body: Habits, shared goals, financial goals and projects, with the progress calculated for you. You can turn it off whenever you like without losing anything.

home.name: Goals
home.hint: Habits, shared goals, financial goals and projects.
home.offHint: Habits, shared goals, financial goals and projects. You can turn it off whenever you like without losing anything.

form.title: Title
form.dueHint: Without a due date the goal is ongoing.
form.periodFixedWeek: Counted per week (it doesn't change after it's created).
form.periodFixedMonth: Counted per month (it doesn't change after it's created).
form.targetWeek: How many times per week (1 to 7)
form.targetMonth: How many times per month (1 to 31)
form.daysHint: With no day picked, any day counts. Checking in outside the agreed days is allowed and stays in the history.

remind.label: Daily reminder
remind.hint: One reminder a day that still matters: we don't remind you if you already checked in, if you already reached the period's goal, or outside the agreed days.

requires.any: Counts when either of you checks in
requires.both: Counts when both of you check in

source.contributionsHint: You record what you've saved. It's only a record: the app doesn't move money.
source.budgetHint: Counts what's left of a category's limit, month by month. Only shared expenses count.
source.financeOff: Budget savings needs the Finances module turned on.
source.noLimits: No category has a budget limit yet. Set a limit in Finances, on the Summary tab.

steps.tasks: Create a task for each step
steps.tasksHint: Tasks show up in Tasks and in Today, and the step is ready when the task is completed.

errors.title: The title needs 1 to 120 characters.
errors.dueOnPast: The due date can't be in the past.
errors.amount: Enter an amount between R$ 0.01 and R$ 10,000,000.00.
errors.stepTitle: Each step can have up to 200 characters.

visibility.view: My partner can see the progress
visibility.privateHint: No one else sees this goal.
visibility.viewHint: Your partner sees the title, the due date and the progress. Notes, contributions, check-ins and steps stay yours only.

suggest.financial: You've reached the amount. Complete the goal?
suggest.project: All the steps are done. Complete the goal?

edit.title: Edit goal
edit.conflict: Your partner changed this goal before you. We loaded the current version: check it and save again.

delete.title: Delete goal?
delete.body: “{{title}}” and all of its history will be deleted.
delete.tasks: Tasks linked to the steps will be canceled (completed ones stay as history).

notFound.title: We couldn't find this goal
notFound.body: It may have been deleted, or you don't have access.

habit.title: Habit
habit.pausedNote: Paused: the reminder is suspended and nothing is reset.

shared.title: Shared goal
shared.countsAny: Counts when either of you checks in.
shared.countsBoth: Counts when both of you check in.
shared.noneToday: No one has checked in today.
shared.waitingOther: Still open for the other person on: {{days}}.

financial.title: Saved so far
financial.budgetOf: Counts what's left of the {{category}} limit each month.
financial.budgetHint: Counts what's left of the category's limit each month. Only shared expenses count.
financial.provisional: The current month can still change.
financial.unavailable: Available when Finances is turned on.

contribution.title: Contributions
contribution.notice: This is only a record for the goal. It doesn't create an expense or touch the settle-up; to record the expense, use Finances.

project.title: Steps
project.syncPending: Creating the task… the step is already saved and the task will show up shortly.

step.title: Title
step.assigneeInTask: With a task, the assignee is changed in the Tasks screen.
step.asTask: Create a task for this step
step.asTaskHint: The step is ready when the task is completed.
step.removeConfirmTask: Remove this step and cancel the linked task?
